name: 講座説明のシート
prompt:
Create ONE isolated Japanese syllabus description sheet. Input1 ORIGINAL Coursera screenshot is PRIMARY for close-icon glyph shape, proportions, optical stroke, header alignment and fine sheet anatomy. Input2 Japanese native mock is SECONDARY for the exact existing condensed Japanese content, line breaks and locked text metrics. Input3 provides official Lighthouse finish only; no bus content.
Scope source x0 y209 width1179 height1898 in1179x2676. No background app, status bar, university name, home indicator or branding. White sheet about390x640 logical units with16px top corner radius, pure white header/body/canvas, no gray header wash or mint. Compact readable left margins16, text column358. Fine neutral divider below the header aroundy50.
Header: left small close X about16x16 atx16,y17, matching original's rounded modest stroke, color coherent slate #526173 instead of mock thick green. Center EXACT「シラバス」in Meiryo BOLD14px line24, letter spacing0. Do not enlarge to20.
All section headings are Meiryo BOLD14/24. ALL body copy is Meiryo REGULAR40014/24 with zero letter spacing, dark #1D1D1D, visibly finer than headings. Retain these exact Japanese lines and punctuation:
At y64 heading「説明」. Body startingy94, exactly five lines:
読み書きや計算と同じように、プログラミングは
これからの学びの基礎となります。
この講座では計算機科学の基本を学びます。
科学、工学、芸術、人文科学など、さまざまな
分野につながる考え方を身につけましょう。
At y230 heading「事前に必要な知識」. Body y260, exactly three lines:
大学初年次の学習者を想定しています。
特別な準備は不要ですが、基礎的な数学を
理解していると取り組みやすくなります。
At y348 heading「講義」. Body y378, two lines:
週に約75分の講義を1回受講します。
講義は4〜6本の短い映像に分かれています。
At y442 heading「読む教材」. Body y472, two lines:
講座では指定された教科書の前半を扱います。
例題を動かしながら読み進めましょう。
No additional prose, English, links, icons, buttons or labels. Preserve Japanese native wording rather than expanding the source's longer English paragraphs. Exact count of four sections, clear hierarchy, no wrap changes or overlap. Ordinary white surfaces and slate utility icon; no primary CTA or extra accent needed. High-resolution flat UI raster.
reviewNotes: All four Japanese sections and 5/3/2/2 body lines visually inspected; title/heading/body roles and slate close X preserved. Black wedges appear outside the rounded top corners instead of pure white canvas. One narrow background correction follows. Static raster only; exact text encoding/native metrics/actions unproven.
